title: fix(spec): PermissionSet.description liveness cites its live reader, Studio's permission-set list column
body:
Fixes #23404

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

The liveness ledger had `PermissionSet.description` as `live`, but its evidence named two readers that no longer exist: `sys-permission-set.object.ts` (removed at C3 stage 8) and `permission-set-projection.ts` (removed at stage 7a). This PR re-checked whether the key still has a reader, as the card asked (measurement first). It does, in objectui. Studio's permission-set list shows the authored `description` as a column. The `description` row in `packages/spec/liveness/permission.json` now cites that reader, so the status stays `live`. `verifiedAt` moves to 2026-10-14, `evidenceScope` is `cross-repo`, and the note records the re-check. The `label` row next to it had the same stale evidence (the record title of the sys_permission_set row object, retired at C3 stage 8). It now cites the same reader, the `label` list column at builtinComponents.tsx:206, with the same ResourceListPage.tsx:698 and getMetaItems citations, `evidenceScope: cross-repo` and `verifiedAt` 2026-10-14. No other row changes. *(Added by the seat at its review: the claim was amended to take the `label` row.)*

A patch changeset (`.changeset/23404-permission-set-description-liveness.md`) comes with it, because `liveness/` is in `@objectstack/spec`'s `files[]` and ships in the package.

## The measurement

**Where the reader is** (objectui; read through `git` at the `.objectui-sha` pin `b9814b334d8a` and at objectui `main` `524136ea7`, identical at both):
- `packages/app-shell/src/services/builtinComponents.tsx:194-208` registers the `permission` metadata resource with `listColumns` `name`, `label`, `description`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx:329` gets the rows through `client.list(type)`, which is `GET /api/v1/meta/permission` (`packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts#list`). Line 698 renders `row.item[c.key]` for each column through `defaultCell`. The page is mounted at `metadata/:type` (`packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:1014`).
- The other `permission` registration (`anchors.ts:373`) sets no `listColumns`, and `registerMetadataResource` merges a later registration into the earlier one, so the column stays. `resolveResourceConfig` does not change the columns either.
- On the framework side, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts#getMetaItems` serves the flattened authored body without projecting it. The only built-in redactor is for `datasource` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-redaction.ts`), so the authored `description` reaches the column.
- The README's display/behaviour table says that for a display-only key, being shown to a human is the whole of the claimed effect. So this reader is enough for `live`.

**Where else I searched, and why those hits are not readers** (objectstack `origin/main` `7b3d5585c`):
- `git grep` for `(ps|set|permissionSet|…)?.description` across every package `src` returned three hits:
  - `packages/core/src/security/permission-set-row-definition.ts:105` turns a legacy `sys_permission_set` row INTO the key, for the `os migrate` ceremony. That makes it a producer, not a reader.
  - The other two (`email-template-row-definition.ts`, `position-row-definition.ts`) belong to other types.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src`: every `description` hit is a producer (the built-in sets in `default-permission-sets.ts` author it), object-field metadata, or a comment. The security catalog never reads the key.
- `packages/rest/src` and `packages/metadata/src`: the hits project other things (docs trees, type entries), not a permission set's body.
- i18n (`spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`) and the CLI `explain`: nothing about permission sets.
- MCP/AI tools: no tool lists permission sets with their description.
- The console bundle is not in this repo (`packages/console` tracks no `dist/`).
- objectui `@object-ui/types`: no `PermissionSet` type.
- objectui `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` (the edit page): no `description` read. `PermissionPreview.tsx:118` reads an RLS policy's `description`, not the set's.

**Positive control:** the same search, run for `label`, finds its reader in the same place: the same `listColumns` entry, rendered by the same `ResourceListPage.tsx:698`. **Negative control:** `managedBy`, which the ledger records as `dead`, has no column there. The comment at `builtinComponents.tsx:200-203` says it was removed on purpose.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:liveness`: green on the final tree. The run includes "every `path#symbol` anchor names a symbol its file contains, and every cited file names the property it is evidence for".
- **Two ablations, both run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which confirmed each mutation was written to disk and restored the file byte-identical to `HEAD` (`git diff HEAD` empty, blob `11c4ba2944a2`):**
  - Renaming the cited path to `protocolAblated.ts` turns the gate red with `1 'live' … entr(ies) cite a file that is missing from THIS repo`.
  - Renaming the anchor to `#getMetaItemz` turns it red with `permission/description → packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts#getMetaItemz` under "anchored citation(s) name a symbol the cited file does not contain".
  - So the new framework-side citation is one the gate actually checks. The old basenames were not: they read as prose.
  - A first anchor attempt was a no-op: the replacement text contained the anchor, so the tool refused to run it. It was redone with the replacement above.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 60 commands. All 60 ran, and `--ran` reconciles them: 58 run, 2 NOT MEASURED.
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET). They need a full-workspace `dist/`, and only `@objectstack/spec` was built here. Left to CI.
  - `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is red, on stale `#symbol` anchors in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/{access-security,attachments-storage,search}.json` that point at `protocol.ts` and `attachment-access-hooks.ts`. This diff touches none of those files: `git diff 7b3d5585c -- docs packages/metadata-protocol packages/services` is empty. It is not caused by this PR.
  - Every other derived command exited 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run test:repo` (pre-merge head `bd9f64e90`): `Test Files  60 passed (60)` · `Tests  1029 passed (1029)`, lock verdict `command-exit 0`.
- After merging `origin/main` `8d5b7bb94` (head `0707d4a5d`): `check:liveness` exit 0 (both ✓ lines), `check:nul-bytes` exit 0, and `check:platform-checklist` still exit 1 with the same 8 problems, which places that red on `main`, not on this diff.

- Patch round 1, head `0303ba5c9`: `check:liveness` exit 0. All 60 derived commands ran: 58 measured, 2 NOT MEASURED (exit 3). The platform-checklist red is unchanged and is on main.

## Acceptance notes

- `evidence.mts` treats a path that is not rooted at `packages/…` (or another top-level directory) as prose. This is by design and documented in its own header and the README. So a `live` row whose evidence names only basenames is never checked. A walk over the ledger found 99 of 446 `live` rows with no path the gate can resolve (local or foreign), and `permission/label` was one of them before this PR.
